result.answer: The patient administration system (PAS) sent a transfer to WARD-B, bed BAY2-04, at 08:20 UTC. It failed because the bed-management system was unavailable. No receipt exists, so that transfer never arrived. Separately, the bed manager (BEDMGR) sent its own transfer for the same patient with the same time, 08:20 UTC, to WARD-C, bed BAY1-07. That one was applied, so the bed-management system now shows the patient on WARD-C. Neither move is later than the other, so Shutter cannot tell which is right. Resending the PAS transfer would move the patient from WARD-C to WARD-B and overwrite the bed manager's placement. This site does not say which system decides ward placement, so Shutter wrote nothing and passed the case to a person (escalate). If the site had named BEDMGR as the deciding system, this case would have closed as superseded, still with no write (W1). Next step: the integration team should confirm whether the patient is really on WARD-B or WARD-C and decide what to do. I can't approve or resend anything myself.

response.content: I sent in the answer: nothing was written because two systems moved the patient at the same time, 08:20 UTC, to different wards (WARD-B and WARD-C), so the case has gone to a person to decide which is right.
